title: 漓江游船之旅
subtitle: 乘船穿越中国最美山水画卷，从桂林到阳朔的83公里诗意旅程
subtitleEn: Drift through China's most iconic landscape — 83km of living poetry from Guilin to Yangshuo
desc: 乘坐四星级游船或私人竹筏，沿着漓江顺流而下。两岸奇峰林立，翠竹摇曳，途经黄布倒影（20元人民币背景图）、九马画山等经典景点。全程约4小时，是来桂林必体验的项目。
descEn: Board a 4-star cruise ship or private bamboo raft and drift down the emerald Li River. Towering karst peaks, bamboo groves, and traditional fishing villages line the route. Pass the famous 20-Yuan viewpoint and Nine Horses Fresco Hill. A 4-hour journey that defines Guilin travel.
fullDesc:
漓江游船是从桂林到阳朔的经典方式，也是世界上风景最优美的河流旅程之一。游船每日上午从竹江码头出发，沿83公里水路蜿蜒前行。

沿途经过的著名景点包括：象鼻山（起点）、叠彩山、伏波山、九马画山（岩壁上可见9匹骏马图案）、黄布倒影（20元人民币背景图），以及阳朔西街附近的终点码头。

游船分三种档次：三星级经济型（¥210）、四星级标准型（¥300-360）、五星级豪华型（¥450+）。所有船只均提供中英文双语广播解说。建议选择四星级以上船只，体验更佳。

最佳游览季节为4月至10月，此时水量充沛、水位适中。枯水期（11月-次年3月）可能改用磨盘山码头的替代航线。
fullDescEn:
The Li River cruise is the classic way to travel from Guilin to Yangshuo, widely regarded as one of the most beautiful river journeys on Earth. Ships depart daily at 9:00 AM from Zhujiang Pier on an 83-km winding course.

Key highlights include: Elephant Trunk Hill (departure point), Diecai Hill, Fubo Hill, Nine Horses Fresco Hill (where you can spot horse patterns on the cliff face), the famous 20-Yuan Bill Viewpoint at Xingping, and the arrival pier near West Street in Yangshuo.

Three cabin classes are available: 3-star economy (¥210), 4-star standard (¥300–360), and 5-star luxury (¥450+). All ships offer bilingual Mandarin-English audio commentary. We recommend 4-star or above for the best experience.

Best season: April–October when water levels are optimal. During dry season (November–March), an alternative route from Mopanshan Pier may be used.
highlights: 20元人民币背景取景地——兴坪古镇黄布倒影
九马画山：岩壁天然形成九匹骏马图案
船上提供中英文双语讲解服务
建议坐在右侧座位（前半段景色更好）
highlightsEn: The 20-Yuan bill backdrop — Xingping's Yellow Cloth Reflection
Nine Horses Fresco Hill — naturally formed horse patterns on cliff face
Sit on the right side for better views during the first half
tips: 提前通过官网或酒店预订船票，旺季经常售罄
带好护照，购票和登船均需出示
晕船者建议选择下层座位或服用晕船药
阳朔终点后可直接入住当地酒店，无需当天返回桂林
tipsEn: Book tickets via official website or hotel in advance — sells out in peak season
Bring your passport required for ticket purchase and boarding
If prone to seasickness, choose lower deck seats or take medication
You can stay in Yangshuo after arrival — no need to return to Guilin the same day

title: 阳朔骑行探险
subtitle: 租一辆自行车或电瓶车，穿梭在田园山水之间，发现隐藏的美景
subtitleEn: Rent a bike or e-bike and pedal through rice fields and karst peaks — discover hidden gems off the beaten track
desc: 阳朔是中国的自行车天堂。沿着十里画廊骑行，穿过稻田、橘园和小村庄。遇龙河沿岸更是精华路线，清澈河水与青山翠竹交相辉映。
descEn: Yangshuo is China's cycling paradise. Ride along the Ten-Mile Gallery, through rice fields, orange groves, and tiny villages. The Yulong River route is the crown jewel — crystal-clear waters flanked by emerald peaks and bamboo.
fullDesc:
阳朔周边拥有中国最适合骑行的乡村道路网络。十里画廊（约10公里）是最经典的路线，沿途有月亮山、大榕树、蝴蝶泉等景点。路况平坦，适合所有年龄段游客。

更具挑战性的路线是遇龙河沿岸骑行（约15公里），需要穿过乡间小道和石桥，风景绝美但需一定体力。沿途可随时停下来在农家乐用餐或在河边休息。

租车非常便利：普通自行车约¥20/天，山地车¥30-50/天，电动助力车¥50-80/天。阳朔县城几乎所有旅馆都提供租车服务。

最佳骑行时间为清晨（7-9点）或傍晚（16-18点），避开正午高温。春秋两季气候最宜人。
fullDescEn:
Yangshuo boasts the best rural cycling road network in China. The Ten-Mile Gallery (~10km) is the classic route, passing Moon Hill, Big Banyan Tree, and Butterfly Spring. The terrain is flat and suitable for all ages.

For more adventure, try the Yulong River route (~15km) along country lanes and stone bridges — stunning but requires moderate fitness. Stop anytime at family-run restaurants or riverside rest areas.

Rental is convenient everywhere: regular bikes ~¥20/day, mountain bikes ¥30–50/day, e-bikes ¥50–80/day. Nearly every guesthouse in Yangshuo rents bikes.

Best riding times: early morning (7–9 AM) or late afternoon (4–6 PM) to avoid midday heat. Spring and autumn offer the most pleasant conditions.
highlights: 十里画廊——10公里风景如画的乡村公路
遇龙河——比漓江更宁静的清澈河流，可漂流也可骑行
月亮山——天然形成的月形穿山洞
沿途农家乐可品尝正宗农家菜
highlightsEn: Ten-Mile Gallery — 10km of picture-perfect country roads
Yulong River — quieter than the Li River, perfect for rafting or cycling
Moon Hill — natural arch shaped like a crescent moon
Family-run restaurants serve authentic farmhouse cuisine along the way
tips: 戴好头盔，注意交通安全（虽然车辆不多）
携带防晒霜、遮阳帽和充足饮水
手机下载离线地图，部分区域信号较弱
遇龙河上可以换乘竹筏漂流，体验两种交通方式
tipsEn: Wear a helmet and watch for traffic (though vehicles are few)
Pack sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of drinking water
Download offline maps — mobile signal is weak in some areas
Switch to a bamboo raft on the Yulong River for two experiences in one

title: 鸬鹚捕鱼体验
subtitle: 观看传承千年的古老渔法，感受漓江渔文化的独特魅力
subtitleEn: Watch a thousand-year-old fishing tradition come alive on the Li River at sunset
desc: 在傍晚时分来到漓江边或遇龙河畔，看渔民指挥训练有素的鸬鹚潜入水中捕鱼。这是桂林最具代表性的文化表演之一，摄影爱好者不容错过。
descEn: Head to the Li or Yulong River at dusk to watch fishermen command trained cormorants diving for fish. One of Guilin's most iconic cultural experiences — a photographer's dream.
fullDesc:
鸬鹚捕鱼是中国（尤其是长江流域）传承千年的古老渔业方式。在桂林地区，这种传统至今仍被保留下来，主要作为文化展示供游客观赏。

表演通常在日落后进行（约18:30-19:30），地点集中在阳朔周边的遇龙河、兴坪等地。渔民划着竹筏出场，身披蓑衣、头戴斗笠，数只鸬鹚站在船头。随着渔民的口令和手势，鸬鹚依次跃入水中，用喉囊捕捉鱼类并带回船上。

最佳观赏点包括：阳朔工农桥附近、遇龙河旧县村、兴坪古镇码头。部分表演还配有传统的渔火（点燃松明照亮水面）和民乐伴奏。

门票约¥80-150/人，包含竹筏观赏位。建议提前到达占座。
fullDescEn:
Cormorant fishing is an ancient practice dating back over 1,000 years along China's Yangtze basin. In the Guilin region, this tradition survives primarily as a cultural demonstration for visitors.

Performances take place shortly after sunset (~6:30–7:30 PM), mainly along the Yulong River near Yangshuo and at Xingping. Fishermen appear on bamboo rafts wearing traditional straw raincoats and conical hats, with cormorants perched at the bow. On command, the birds dive into the water, catching fish in their throat pouches and returning to the boat.

Prime viewing spots include Gongnong Bridge (Yangshuo), Jiuxian Village (Yulong River), and Xingping Pier. Some shows feature traditional fishing torches (pine firelight on water) and live folk music.

Tickets cost approximately ¥80–150/person, including a viewing position on a raft. Arrive early for the best seats.
highlights: 千年古法的活态传承，世界独一无二的文化景观
夕阳下的漓江水面配合传统渔火，画面极具感染力
近距离观察鸬鹚与渔人的默契配合
绝佳的人文摄影题材，适合各水平摄影师
highlightsEn: A living heritage spanning 1,000 years — unique worldwide cultural experience
Sunset on the Li River with traditional fishing torches — incredibly atmospheric
Observe the remarkable bond between cormorants and fishermen up close
Outstanding subject for cultural photography at any skill level
tips: 携带三脚架和广角镜头，低光环境需要稳定支撑
提前确认当日表演时间和地点（受天气影响可能取消）
尊重渔民和鸬鹚，不要使用闪光灯惊扰动物
可与阳朔骑行或遇龙河竹筏行程组合安排
tipsEn: Bring a tripod and wide-angle lens — low light requires stability
Confirm show time and location in advance (weather-dependent cancellations possible)
Respect fishermen and birds — no flash photography to avoid startling animals
Combine with a Yangshuo cycling or Yulong River rafting itinerary

title: 桂林美食探索
subtitle: 从米粉到啤酒鱼，舌尖上的桂林让你回味无穷
subtitleEn: From rice noodles to beer fish — discover why Guilin is a hidden gem of Chinese cuisine
desc: 桂林菜属粤菜系分支，以酸辣鲜香为特色。必尝美食包括桂林米粉、阳朔啤酒鱼、荔浦芋头扣肉等。参加美食导览团或自行探索夜市小吃。
descEn: Guilin cuisine blends Cantonese influences with bold local flavors — sour, spicy, fresh, and aromatic. Must-try dishes include Guilin rice noodles, Yangshuo beer fish, and Lipu taro pork belly. Join a food tour or explore night markets independently.
fullDesc:
桂林美食是广西菜的重要组成部分，融合了粤菜的精致与少数民族饮食的粗犷豪放。其核心特色是「酸辣鲜香」，善用辣椒、酸笋、豆豉和本地香草调味。

必尝清单：

  • 桂林米粉（¥5-15）：早餐首选，卤水汤底配卤牛肉片、锅烧、花生米。正宗吃法是干拌而非汤粉。
  • 阳朔啤酒鱼（¥60-120）：新鲜漓江鱼配啤酒烹制，外酥里嫩，微辣开胃。
  • 荔浦芋头扣肉（¥38-68）：广西名菜，芋头绵软香甜，扣肉肥而不腻。
  • 油茶（¥10-20）：恭城瑶族特色饮品，用茶叶、生姜、大蒜炒制冲泡。
  • 马蹄糕（¥3-5）：以桂林特产荸荠制作的传统点心。

推荐美食集中地：正阳步行街夜市、文明路美食街、阳朔西街周边。
fullDescEn:
Guilin cuisine is a vital part of Guangxi cooking, blending Cantonese refinement with bold ethnic minority flavors. The defining profile is sour-spicy-fresh-aromatic — heavy use of chili peppers, pickled bamboo shoots, fermented black beans, and local herbs.

Must-Try List:

  • Guilin Rice Noodles (桂林米粉) (¥5–15): The definitive breakfast — savory braised broth topped with beef slices, crispy pork crackling, and peanuts. Authentic style is dry-mixed (干拌), not soup-based.
  • Yangshuo Beer Fish (阳朔啤酒鱼) (¥60–120): Fresh Li River fish cooked in beer — crispy outside, tender inside, mildly spicy and appetizing.
  • Lipu Taro Pork Belly (荔浦芋头扣肉) (¥38–68): A Guangxi classic — silky taro layered with melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly.
  • You Cha (Oil Tea) (¥10–20): A Gongcheng Yao specialty — tea leaves, ginger, and garlic fried and brewed into a savory broth.
  • Water Chestnut Cake (马蹄糕) (¥3–5): Traditional snack made from Guilin's famous water chestnuts.

Recommended food hubs: Zhengyang Pedestrian Street Night Market, Weming Road Food Street, and around Yangshuo West Street.
highlights: 桂林米粉——每天早晨唤醒这座城市的灵魂美食
阳朔啤酒鱼——漓江特产鱼配本地啤酒的独特做法
正阳步行街夜市——一站式品尝数十种地方小吃
恭城油茶——瑶族传统养生饮品，初尝者可能需要适应
highlightsEn: Guilin Rice Noodles — the soul food that wakes up this city every morning
Yangshuo Beer Fish — fresh Li River fish cooked in local beer, a unique preparation
Zhengyang Night Market — sample dozens of local snacks in one place
Gongcheng Oil Tea — a traditional Yao health drink (acquired taste for newcomers!)
tips: 早餐一定要尝试路边小店的自选米粉（比大店更地道）
啤酒鱼价格差异大，先问价再点菜，避免宰客
夜市小吃摊支持微信/支付宝付款，现金也通用
素食者在桂林也能找到选择——告知服务员「不吃肉」即可
tipsEn: For breakfast, try a roadside noodle shop's self-service mifen (more authentic than big restaurants)
Beer fish prices vary widely — always confirm price before ordering
Night market stalls accept WeChat Pay/Alipay; cash works too
Vegetarians can find options in Guilin — just tell staff 'no meat' (不吃肉)
